groups.activity: free two Companion slots before claiming

rows.label: free Companion slots
rows.note: one for Diriga, one for the Vulklok

conditions: The Vulklok has no blueprint and no drop of its own; building Diriga is the only way to get it.
With only one free slot the claim is blocked.

groups.activity: Capture, then break every container and Argon Pegmatite
conditions: Argon collected before today's GMT 00:00 reset is halved at each reset, rounded down; farm the two, then build the same day.
Cancelling a Foundry build does not return its Argon.
bonuses: A max-range Xaku (The Vast Untime) or Limbo (Cataclysm) breaks containers and deposits through walls; 1-4 crystals per short run is typical.
Dropped Argon is auto-waypointed on the minimap.

disclosures.title: other Argon options
disclosures.body: Mot or Ani (Void Survival) with a loot frame (Nekros, Khora with Pilfering Strangledome, Hydroid with Pilfering Swarm) gets 2-4 in a short round, and Mot spawns Corrupted Vor, a 50% chance at Argon over an Orokin Cell. Public queues on Hepit and Mot are full of players farming Argon, and Void Fissures on Void nodes drop crystals while you crack relics. A Resource Booster, a Relay resource blessing, Smeeta's Charm and Resourceful Retriever all stack on pickups.

rows.label: Diriga
rows.note: 600 Alloy Plate, 2 Argon Crystal, 350 Plastids, 500 Polymer Bundle

conditions: The Vulklok is its own Mastery item; level it and Diriga to 30, and keep Diriga until both are done.
